verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Persona offers native Mobile SDKs and an Embedded web Flow as the 'most comprehensive' integration option (persona-docs-20), implying camera-based document capture, but there is no evidence describing glare, blur, or edge-detection coaching features guiding users to a usable photo. missing for 10: specific documentation of in-SDK capture UX (glare/blur detection, edge detection, first-try guidance), any hands-on or independent corroboration of capture quality coaching.
